limitations: The intended company group and accounting basis are unspecified.
Base44's founder-reported monthly profit is not reconciled to quarterly net income after all expenses [e1].
The packet lacks comparable quarterly financial records for the complete intended group.
The classification “real businesses” has no independent financial test.

criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one company within the intended group has positive company-level profit during the target period on a comparable, established accounting basis.
